newsitem.title: MEXICO: RESEARCH ALERT - Coca-Cola Femsa raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Coca-Cola Femsa raised.

text.p: JP Morgan Securities Inc said it had raised its earnings estimate for Coca Cola Femsa for the fourth quarter and for the year.

-- "We expect Coke Femsa's fourth quarter and full year 1996 earnings per ADR, which should be released during the week of February 24, to reach U.S. $0.40 and U.S. $1.05, respectively, which compare with earnings per ADR of U.S. $0.23 and U.S. $0.86 reported in the fourth quarter and full year 1995," wrote analyst Annette Franqui.

-- "Net income for the quarter is expected to reach 150.8 million pesos, up 31.5 percent from a year ago, while for the year we are expecting net income of 392.5 million pesos, down 4.9 percent in real terms from a year ago," she wrote.
-- In dollar terms, however, both the quarter and the year are up, she said.
